verdict.rationale: Autumn documents recurring plans defined in code and synced via the CLI. Its attach endpoint handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades, and supporting docs cover a preview of charges before a subscription change, multi-phase schedules, multi-plan consolidated subscriptions, a customer billing portal, and plan-change webhooks. Community discussion corroborates handling of annual/monthly billing transitions. Missing for 10: any evidence of free-trial support, explicit proration documentation (only implied by the charge preview), and independent hands-on corroboration of upgrade billing behavior.
